---
title: "Restyling the viewer"
subtitle: "panzoom: css-class"
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  css-class: dark-viewer
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <style>
    .dark-viewer {
      --panzoom-backdrop: #000;
      --panzoom-bg: #000;
      --panzoom-fg: #eee;
    }
    </style>
    <script>
    // Quarto writes this after panzoom's stylesheet; move it before, where
    // only the variables' zero specificity lets it win.
    document.head.prepend(document.currentScript.previousElementSibling);
    </script>
---

::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests `css-class` and the viewer's CSS variables**:
`css-class: dark-viewer` adds that class to the viewer, next to
`panzoom-overlay`, and a rule on `.dark-viewer` sets the backdrop and the
caption band to black. The rule is moved to the top of the page's
header, before panzoom's stylesheet, so it also checks that the
variables' defaults never win over it. It is not part of the website.
:::
